top_violation_types.title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play Space - Hazards Removed or Repaired (26 TAC §747.4407(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operations active play space was observed to have a hoe, weeder, and multiple shovels present. The operations backyard fence has multiples gaps measuring larger than 3.5 inches and less than 9 inches.

top_violation_types.title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Pet Vaccinations (26 TAC §747.801(6))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two cats and two dogs do not have up to date vaccinations.

top_violation_types.title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §747.3501)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A propane tank was observed in an outdoor area accessible to children.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §747.3935(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The permit holder has not completed the annual certification.

top_violation_types.title: Liability Insurance Requirements -  Provide Proof of Coverage Annually by Anniversary Date of Listing (26 TAC §742.403(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation has not verified liability insurance.

top_violation_types.title: Must Have at Least One 3A-40BC Dry Chemical Fire Extinguisher or Fire Extinguisher Approved by Fire Marshal (26 TAC §747.5103)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation was observed to have a fire extinguisher 1A-10 BC instead of the required 3A-40BC fire extinguisher.

top_violation_types.title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §747.5005(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The caregiver did not practice fire drill monthly since 01/2022.

top_violation_types.title: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training - Primary, Assistant, and Substitute Caregivers (26 TAC §747.1313(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The primary caregivers pediatric cpr training expired 09/2023.
